description: Validates that collaboration diagrams were generated with valid-looking Mermaid, traceable metadata, and supported participant syntax

checks.description: Both collaboration diagram files must exist
checks.remediation: Run diagram-generatecollaboration on domain-concepts.json and requirements.json

checks.description: The Markdown output must contain at least one Mermaid diagram and no stub marker
checks.remediation: Generate the diagrams; a file with no fenced mermaid block is not a diagram output

checks.description: Participants must not use the @{ ... } metadata form, which most Mermaid renderers reject
checks.remediation: Declare participants as 'participant Alias as "Label"' and record stereotypes in a '%% Stereotypes:' comment

checks.description: The JSON output must carry a non-empty diagrams list
checks.remediation: Write the diagrams array per references/output-format.md

checks.description: Every diagram must have an ID, title, and type
checks.remediation: Give each diagram a D-[###] id, a title, and its Mermaid type

checks.description: Diagrams should cite the requirements they visualize
Interaction diagrams should contain message flows
checks.remediation: Add the interactions between participants; a sequence diagram with no messages shows nothing
